carousel: Crossed out: waiting weeks for approval, guessing the final bill. MRI for $295. No referral needed. MRI $295, with contrast $395, Open and 3T also $295. Radiologist reading included, no facility fees added later, same-day often available.

How it works, self-pay: 1, book: call us or book online. 2, same-day review: our physician reviews your request the same day, no referral needed. 3, get scanned: often the same day, results in 48 to 72 hours.

What $295 gets you: one price, everything included. Reading by a board-certified radiologist; no fees added later for the facility or the reading; three scanners, 1.5T, Open MRI and 3T, all the same price; HSA and FSA cards accepted.

The Advanced Medical Imaging team in their black scrubs at the Seminole office. Two locations, one number: Seminole has 1.5T and Open MRI, St. Pete has 3T MRI on Central Ave. Call (727) 398-5999 for today's openings.
